semantic.justification: Consumed native CSS paragraph margin/indent/spacing/background handlers and actual HTML context insertion operate on existing document-pool items, original signed flags, nearest context lookup and pending paragraph margin owners. No browser CSS parser or new kernel value family is substituted. Block RES_BACKGROUND is represented; distinct inline RES_CHRATR_BACKGROUND remains absent and is not mapped to highlight. Native token/narrowing/shorthand quirks are retained. Actual model, Markdown/Worker and mounted paragraph UI evidence covers these callers. Generic positioning/style-graph/table/background-image and unconsumed branches remain unverified; no whole-filter or compiled upstream promotion. S3HW1E connects actual ID and no-HREF named targets to native queued point bookmarks. Filter-private RES_FLTR_BOOKMARK is174, with no document pool default. Actual HTMLAttr can retain a null table for unheaded queued marks; SetAttr_ uses exact original name/position deduplication, raw offset clamping and real DocumentMarkAccess name allocation. HTML ID/font/style consumers retain source option order. Native implicit target separator and Unambiguous decode selection preserve encoded name spelling; WRITER221 documents queue-boundary naming. Actual parser/Markdown/Worker/RTF tests cover this profile; language/direction/section/HREF and full filter parity remain open.
